description: Unit test class for ProgramValidator in the OpenMRS project, testing validation logic for Program entity.

classes.name: ProgramValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ProgramValidator, verifying various validation rules on Program objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfProgramNameAlreadyInUse
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program name already exists in the system.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation passes if the Program description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfConceptIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the Program concept is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all required fields are properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationAndSaveEditedProgram
methods.description: Verifies that a Program with valid edits passes validation and is correctly saved.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when string field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails if the 'name' field exceeds length constraints.
